summary: I fixed the bug in `solution/util.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). `_parse` stored numeric prerelease identifiers as strings, tagged the same way as alphanumeric ones. That made `"11"` sort before `"2"` lexicographically. Numeric identifiers are now stored as `(0, int(ident))`. They compare numerically, and they rank below alphanumeric identifiers, as the semver spec requires. `core.py` didn't need any change.
